Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement wants to get Redwood set up in our vendor master so we can route POs and get the first test order out. I attached a completed W-9 and our certificate of incorporation; AP also attached a short vendor intake form (see attached spreadsheet).

Can you confirm the legal name and remit details you need on your side? Our usual remit is: Thermocorp Industries, 4122 Expo Way, Suite 900, San Jose, CA 95134.

If you need a contact for invoicing we can use ap@thermocorp.com, attention to accounts payable.

Attach: Thermocorp_W-9.pdf, Thermocorp_Certificate_of_Incorporation.pdf, supplier-onboarding-form.xlsx

Best,
Angela Ruiz

Hi Angela — thanks for sending everything over and for the clear remit.

Quick confirmation of what we need to create the vendor master record on our side:
- Legal entity name (as shown on W-9)
- Tax ID / EIN (we can accept redacted if needed, but full needed for payment setup)
- Remit address (physical or mailing)
- Primary AP contact (email and name)
- Preferred payment method (ACH, Wire, Check)
- Bank details or vendor portal link (if you prefer to submit directly)

I’m looping in Lauren from Finance to confirm our internal payment cadence and to share Redwood’s supplier intake checklist. Lauren — can you review Angela’s files and let us know if you need anything else to enable ACH setup? If all looks good we can create the vendor record and issue a test PO next week (PO-4821).

Marissa Cole

Hi all — reviewed Angela’s attachments. A couple of notes and a small ask:

1) W-9: Good. The legal name on the W-9 matches the incorporation certificate, so legal name validation passed.
2) Remit address: San Jose address is fine for mail; for ACH we need company name and the ACH beneficiary name to match the W-9.
3) Missing: bank routing/account details (we can accept a voided check or a bank letter). If Thermocorp prefers not to share bank details over email, we can send a secure upload link.
4) Tax/EIN: We have the last four digits on record from the W-9; if you can share the full EIN through the secure channel that will expedite set up.

Action items: Angela — please either upload the bank letter at the Drive link Lauren provided or tell us if you prefer a DocuSign secure form. Once we have that we’ll finish the vendor master creation and route PO-4821 to your AP inbox.

Attach: Redwood_Supplier_Checklist_v1.pdf (internal)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Office: (650) 555-0330
